host_out_amplitude.description: Encoded differential peak-peak amplitude at TP1a for HostOut lane <lane>; shared-memory in/out parameter of the amplitude setting and tuning procedures.

host_out_amplitude_tune.description: Amplitude tuning instruction requested for HostOut lane <lane>; default step size 50 mV; value 3 sets the amplitude given in HostOut<lane>Amplitude.

host_out_ffe_tap_1.description: SM8-encoded FFE tap 1 value for HostOut lane <lane>: sign in bit 7 (0 positive, 1 negative), magnitude 0..127 in bits 6-0 with 0.01 per LSB, i.e. a tap value range of -1.27 to +1.27. Shared-memory in/out parameter of the tap setting and tuning procedures; when advertised, the host keeps the register current under tuning operations and preset loading.

host_out_ffe_tap_1_saturated.description: Indicates that the tap value limit was reached on FFE tap 1 of HostOut lane <lane> during an increment/decrement tuning request; the request fails and leaves the tap value unchanged.

host_out_ffe_tap_1_tune.description: Tuning instruction for FFE tap 1 of HostOut lane <lane>, inside the atomically updated U16 per-lane tuning register at bytes 196-211; instructions for unused taps are ignored. Default step size 0.02.

host_out_invoke_tuning_flag.description: Tuning procedure invoked per lane: 0: no tuning request for lane <lane>, 1: tuning request for lane <lane>; the type of tuning requested (amplitude or taps) is programmed in HostOut<lane>TuningType. M2H message bit, clear on read.

host_out_output_saturated.description: Indicates that the output amplitude of HostOut lane <lane> saturated at the minimum or maximum amplitude during an adjustment request; a permanent status indication.

host_out_training_done_flag.description: Flag to the host after completion of egress training: 0: egress training not started or not yet completed, 1: egress training completed; the host should examine training status (Table 15) and training result (Table 16). M2H message bit, clear on read.

host_out_tuning_completed_trig.description: The host notifies the module about completion of a tuning procedure for lane <lane> (with or without success): 0: no tuning requested or not yet completed, 1: requested operation completed. H2M message bit, self-clearing.

host_out_tuning_type.description: Type of tuning requested for lane <lane> when the tuning procedure is invoked: 0: FFE tap tuning (Table 33), 1: output amplitude tuning (Table 34).

mod_hsin_current_sqm.description: Current SQM readout on ModHsIn receive lane <lane>; a U8 value of s encodes the SQM value 10 + s/10. There are no notifications to the host when values change; it is the host's responsibility to monitor these registers when needed.

mod_hsin_sqm_alarm_flag.description: SQM degraded alarm indicator to the host: 0: no SQM degraded alarm latched since last read, 1: SQM degraded alarm latched since last read. The table is titled '(Page 50h)' in the parsed spec but the register is defined in section 6.3.6 on page 51h byte 229; recorded on page 51h (see namespace README).
